deviations_from_card: (1) Commit order: feat, then the test commit, then package.json. All 6 cases are red until the feature lands, so the suite rides in a test commit AFTER the fix (the brief allows this). Red-before was measured by running the suite against HEAD 7e47fbd sources in a temp copy: 6 red, 2 guards green. (2) The card says post returns the Response, but LingaPhone.tsx and LingaTV.tsx (outside the write set) type post as (e)=>Promise<void>. phone/page.tsx and tv/page.tsx therefore pass them a stable postOnly wrapper (useCallback); those two files are unchanged. (3) The desk-tv cookie holds HMAC(key,'tv') rather than the key itself, so the key never rides in a cookie. (4) A guest may also post {type:'leave'}: the Forget button sits on the join panel. (5) The gate is derived from src/app/api on disk, so /api/listen and /api/smoke are 401 to a guest too (the card lists 10 routes; disk has 12 gated). (6) A TV page whose viewer is 'phone' also draws the 'Not this desk's TV' line, not only a guest. (7) instrumentation.ts must use the documented `if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'nodejs') { await import(...) }` block. An early return left the node:crypto import in the edge compile ('UnhandledSchemeError node:crypto'); this was found on the real dev server and fixed before commit. (8) The eyebrow on the guest line was dropped (22px < the 28px On Air floor). (9) The dev server was run from a temp copy of desk/ with a node_modules junction, because the operator's dev server holds desk/.next on :3001.
notes: NEW SESSION API SHAPE. GET /api/session, POST /api/session and every /api/session/stream message return view(session, role) from desk/src/lib/session/pairing.ts. Session gains an optional `viewer?: 'tv'|'phone'|'guest'`, set only on what a route sends and never stored. The role comes from the x-desk-role request header, which src/proxy.ts writes on every /api/* request, overwriting any client value. role 'tv' -> {...session, viewer:'tv'}: the whole session, pin included. role 'phone' -> {...session, pin:'', joined:true, viewer:'phone'}: joined is now per device. role 'guest' -> the lobby: {...session, viewer:'guest', pin:'', joined:false, profiles:[], draft: session.screen==='profile' ? session.draft : null, tasks:[], back:undefined, pages:[], pageIx:0, itemIx:0, reading:false, awaiting:null, hint:null, lesson:null, noLesson:false, lessonPaused:false, english:null, essay:null, essayType:null, essayAt:null, englishLearning:emptyEnglish(), conversation:null, check:null, topic:null, practice:null, walkIx:0, skills:{}, writing:{}, memory:[], history:[], jobs:{}, status:'', log:{problems:[],hints:0,hard:[],minutes:0,started:null}}. It keeps screen, subject, focus, view, learner {id,name}, phoneUrl, timer and updatedAt. NO x-desk-role header means an in-process caller (tests, retry's internal call, uat drivers): the session itself, unchanged, with no viewer. So GET() and stream GET() still accept no argument. The stream re-asks the role for each message (liveRole): a phone whose pin rotated becomes a guest on its open stream. NEW `join` EVENT SHAPE: {type:'join', code?: string}. POST /api/session checks the code against getSession().pin. A guest with no code gets 403 {error:'Type the code the TV shows.'}. Any caller with a wrong code gets 403 {error:'That code is not on the TV.'}. The right code dispatches {type:'join'} (the reducer ignores code; joined=true and screen 'joined' except on profile, as before) and returns 200 with the phone view plus Set-Cookie desk-phone=HMAC-SHA256(key, pin) base64url (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, path /, 400 days). The TV and in-process callers may join without a code (the bench's Fake phone). NEW `leave` EVENT: {type:'leave'}. The route expires desk-phone and returns the guest view; the reducer returns the session unchanged. Guest POST allow-list: join, leave, nav with screen 'pair', and profile.draft whose patch is exactly {name} while the TV is on profile. Everything else is 403 {error:'Join the desk first: type the code the TV shows.'} and the session is unchanged. The proxy answers a guest 401 (same error) on every /api route except GET /api/session, GET /api/session/stream and POST /api/session. The TV key is in DESK_DATA_DIR/pairing.json as {key} only (critic revise); the pin stays on the Session. GET /tv?key=<key> sets desk-tv=HMAC(key,'tv') and redirects 307 to /tv, keeping the other query params (?test=1, ?module=english). instrumentation.ts prints 'TV: http://<ip>:<port>/tv?key=...' at start. CLIENT API: useSession() returns {s, connected, post, reconnect}. post(e) now resolves to the fetch Response. reconnect() reopens the SSE stream: call it after a join or leave, because the stream's role is fixed when it opens (except that a phone lapses to guest). FOR WAVES 2-4: (a) any new Playwright capture of /tv must open /tv?key=<key read from its DESK_DATA_DIR/pairing.json>, and the phone must join via /phone?pin=<pin from the TV view>, since each browser.newPage() is a new cookie jar. A phone joining while the TV is on Linga or any other screen sends the TV to 'joined' (the reducer, unchanged): pair first, then navigate. (b) A new /api route is gated automatically. (c) New HTTP tests must send a cookie; in-process route tests need nothing. (d) The operator's dev server on :3001 (main tree, real data) will pick up proxy.ts on reload. Until it is restarted (which prints the address) or the operator opens /tv?key= with the key from desk/data/pairing.json (written by that server on its first proxied request), its TV shows 'Not this desk's TV'. Operator capture lines naming /tv are listed in the feat commit body. tools/linga-ui-test.cjs now also needs DESK_DATA_DIR in its env. It makes real model calls and was NOT run here; only its syntax was checked. TV screenshots (dev server, Playwright): Not this desk's TV, landing with the key, Pair; phone: On the desk after the QR join. They are in the builder's scratchpad, not in the tree.
